findings.label: schema.ts doc/impl wording
findings.detail: Comment in src/db/schema.ts says the DDL is issued via `.simple()`, but the code runs `database.unsafe(...).simple()`. Harmless wording mismatch; update the comment for accuracy.

findings.label: database.unsafe() usage
findings.detail: `database.unsafe(...)` is used in src/db/schema.ts (static DDL script) and src/api/addresses.ts (static ADDRESS_COLUMNS constant). Both operate only on hardcoded strings, never user input, so they are injection-safe. Would need re-review only if either constant ever became dynamic.
